name: cannibal.r_caol_first_smoke_020_clean_closed_fire_assault
description: R020 independent ordinary-view clean closed-window smoke-to-cannibal-assault arm; exact pre-signal prepared start, geometry setup-only.

steps.label: load_clean_closed_window_pre_signal_checkpoint
steps.expected_visible_fact: Load only the disposable profile whose 45 TestSetup00 save files match build_logs/first-smoke-011/ordinary-closed-smoke-start-manifest.json. Verify effective userdir, same-run World/current turn, Safe mode Off, no clairvoyance/cloak/invulnerability, no pending input, unlit brazier and no prior site knowledge/signal/outing; saved baseline turn 5216234.

steps.label: no_fixture_transforms
steps.expected_visible_fact: No additional fixture transform is declared; camp geometry is the already-recorded controlled setup in the byte-exact manifest.

steps.label: ordinary_closed_fire_smoke_to_cannibal_assault
steps.objective: From the exact prepared pre-signal save, use ordinary gameplay and the charged lighter to light the existing indoor brazier. Keep ordinary player visibility and closed windows; confirm real fire and physical smoke. The cannibal camp geometry itself is controlled setup only; verify actual site/roster/observer natively before credit. Prove the actual smoke channel is admitted before any valid light/contact or previously seeded knowledge; then track native actor IDs through scout/watch/return/report and night raid. Judge pursuit/attack from physical position/actions/target/health and source-attributed damage or death, never phase-only. No clairvoyance, cloak, invulnerability, signal/contact/report injection, teleport or debug raider kill.
proof_targets: exact disposable 45-file save copy and effective userdir; same-run World/current and saved turns; bound source/executable/session
unlit closed-room start with Safe mode Off, no sight mutations, no prior signal/site knowledge/active outing; controlled camp geometry labeled setup only
ordinary lighter activation with the currently advertised item ID and brazier direction; native fd_fire followed by physical fd_smoke
run-bound smoke-channel admission before any light or contact response; exact source/observer/camp and reason fields
same native scout IDs, actual physical three-OMT watch, return and report with native save checkpoints
night raid actor IDs and physical path/actions/targets, effective attack/damage attribution and actual death if it occurs; gore only if explicitly observed
actual saved turns/payload hashes and turn-performance evidence at meaningful transitions
exact game/bridge/launcher PID and birth lifecycle with supported graceful cleanup
invariants: No signal, contact, report, dispatch, hostile teleport, fire or light injection; no debug raider kill
Ordinary-view arm: both clairvoyance mutations, cloak and invulnerability remain absent
Do not call the controlled cannibal-site geometry natural generation or initial site knowledge
Maintain actual brazier fire through observed raid unless a concrete safety blocker requires stopping
Track all relevant actors by native ID/metadata and saved roster, including actors outside sight
At first harm use safe/stop observation; use ignore only deliberately for combat-through-outcome and preserve death attribution
Stop unchanged waits at the first material divergence; keep the first divergent save and transition handle

evidence_contract.claim: A byte-exact pre-signal closed-window save, with only the recorded controlled camp geometry setup, is loaded under the current source-bound executable. Ordinary indoor brazier fire/smoke must yield native smoke admission before valid light/contact, then same-ID scout/watch/return/report and physical night assault.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: Credit only run-bound native signal records, physical actor changes and sourced combat outcomes under verified initial conditions. Preserve first divergence and exact save/session state; setup and campaign phase labels do not establish product behavior.
